add-multi-line-text-watermark-facade.title: Add Multi-Line Text Watermark to PDF using Facades
add-multi-line-text-watermark-facade.description: Shows how to create a multi-line text watermark with Aspose.Pdf.Facades by using FormattedText, adding extra lines via AddNewLineText, and applying it as a background stamp to all pages of a PDF.

rotate-text-stamp-45-degrees.title: Rotate Text Stamp 45 Degrees in PDF
rotate-text-stamp-45-degrees.description: Shows how to add a TextStamp to a PDF page and rotate it 45° around its centre using the RotateAngle property.

apply-pdf-page-stamp-as-background.title: Apply PDF Page Stamp as Background to All Pages
apply-pdf-page-stamp-as-background.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades to stamp every page of a PDF with the first page of another PDF, placing the stamp behind the existing content.

apply-external-pdf-template-stamp.title: Apply External PDF Template as Stamp on a Specific Page
apply-external-pdf-template-stamp.description: Shows how to create a PdfFileStamp from an external template PDF and apply it only to the third page of another PDF document.

add-lower-roman-page-numbers-odd-pages.title: Add Lower‑Roman Page Numbers to Odd Pages
add-lower-roman-page-numbers-odd-pages.description: Demonstrates how to add page numbers in lower‑case Roman numerals to only the odd pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PageNumberStamp.

combine-image-text-pdf-stamp.title: Combine Image and Text into a PDF Stamp
combine-image-text-pdf-stamp.description: Demonstrates creating a single stamp that contains a logo image and formatted text, then applying it to a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-header-stamp-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Header Stamp to All PDF Pages
add-header-stamp-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its Pages collection, and add a centered header TextStamp containing a company name to each page.

add-footer-date-stamp-to-last-pdf-page.title: Add Footer Date Stamp to Last PDF Page
add-footer-date-stamp-to-last-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to insert a footer stamp containing the current date (MM-dd-yyyy) on the last page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-rotating-stamps-to-pdf-pages.title: Apply Rotating Stamps to Each PDF Page
apply-rotating-stamps-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to add a text stamp to every page of a PDF and rotate each stamp based on the page index using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-background-watermark-to-specific-pdf.title: Add Background Watermark to Specific PDF Pages
add-background-watermark-to-specific-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to apply a light‑gray background watermark to pages 2‑5 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

batch-add-multi-line-watermark-to-pdfs.title: Batch Add Multi‑Line Watermark to PDFs
batch-add-multi-line-watermark-to-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to process all PDF files in a folder and apply the same multi‑line text watermark to each document using Aspose.Pdf facades.

add-image-stamp-to-pdfs-preserve-filenam.title: Add Image Stamp to PDFs and Preserve Filenames
add-image-stamp-to-pdfs-preserve-filenam.description: Iterates over PDF files in a source folder, applies an image stamp to each page using the PdfFileStamp facade, and saves the stamped PDFs to a target folder while keeping the original file names.

overlay-legal-disclaimer-with-pdffilesta.title: Overlay Legal Disclaimer on First Page Using PdfFileStamp
overlay-legal-disclaimer-with-pdffilesta.description: Shows how to apply a disclaimer PDF as a background stamp on the first page of multiple target PDFs using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileStamp facade.

apply-translucent-text-watermark.title: Apply Translucent Text Watermark to All PDF Pages
apply-translucent-text-watermark.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades to add a semi‑transparent text watermark to every page of a PDF document.

apply-rotated-image-stamp-to-pdf-pages.title: Apply Rotated Image Stamp to PDF Pages
apply-rotated-image-stamp-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to add an image stamp rotated by 30° to the bottom‑right corner of every page in a PDF using the Aspose.Pdf Facades API.

add-page-number-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Page Number Stamp to PDF
add-page-number-stamp-to-pdf.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileStamp to add a dynamic page‑number stamp (using the "#" placeholder) to every page of a PDF document.

add-multi-line-watermark-custom-font.title: Add Multi‑Line Watermark with Custom Font to PDF
add-multi-line-watermark-custom-font.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a memory stream and applying a multi‑line, custom‑styled watermark using Aspose.Pdf.Facades stamp classes.

add-footer-stamp-10-points-above-bottom.title: Add Footer Stamp 10 Points Above Bottom Edge
add-footer-stamp-10-points-above-bottom.description: Demonstrates how to use PdfFileStamp to add a footer stamp positioned exactly 10 points above the bottom edge of each PDF page.

apply-stamp-to-even-pdf-pages.title: Apply Stamp to Even PDF Pages
apply-stamp-to-even-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to add a text stamp only to even-numbered pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf facades.

qr-code-and-text-stamp-for-pdf.title: Create QR Code and Text Stamp for PDF Verification
qr-code-and-text-stamp-for-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a QR‑code image stamp together with a descriptive text stamp to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf Facades.

apply-text-stamp-to-specific-pdf-pages.title: Apply Text Stamp to Specific PDF Pages
apply-text-stamp-to-specific-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to add a text watermark (stamp) to only pages 1, 5, and 10 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

overlay-image-stamp-on-pdf-pages.title: Overlay Image Stamp on PDF Pages
overlay-image-stamp-on-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to add an image stamp that overlays existing PDF content by setting the stamp's IsBackground property to false using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-transparent-confidential-text-stamp.title: Add Transparent Confidential Text Stamp to Selected PDF Pages
add-transparent-confidential-text-stamp.description: Demonstrates applying a 70% opaque red "CONFIDENTIAL" text stamp to specific pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf Facades.

custom-font-stamp-branding.title: Add Custom Font Stamp to PDF for Branding
custom-font-stamp-branding.description: Shows how to load a TrueType font from a file, create a formatted text stamp using that font, and apply the stamp to a PDF with Aspose.Pdf facades.

add-page-number-stamp-leading-zeros.title: Add Page Number Stamp with Leading Zeros to PDF
add-page-number-stamp-leading-zeros.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf to stamp Arabic numeral page numbers with leading zeros on every page of a PDF document.

batch-apply-rotated-pdf-stamp.title: Batch Apply Rotated PDF Stamp to PDFs
batch-apply-rotated-pdf-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to iterate over PDFs in a network share and apply a rotated stamp taken from another PDF to every page, saving the results to an output folder.

multi-line-watermark-addnewlinetext.title: Create Multi‑Line Watermark Using AddNewLineText
multi-line-watermark-addnewlinetext.description: Demonstrates how to build a three‑line watermark with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormattedText using AddNewLineText, bind it to a Stamp, and apply it to a PDF document.

add-right-aligned-logo-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Right-Aligned Logo Stamp to PDF
add-right-aligned-logo-stamp-to-pdf.description: Shows how to place an image stamp (logo) at the right margin of each page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-semi-transparent-png-background-st.title: Apply Semi-Transparent PNG Background Stamp to PDF
apply-semi-transparent-png-background-st.description: Demonstrates how to add a semi‑transparent PNG image as a background stamp that covers the entire page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-creation-date-stamp.title: Add Creation Date Stamp to PDF
add-creation-date-stamp.description: Shows how to read a PDF's creation date and place it as a text stamp in the top‑left corner of every page using Aspose.Pdf.

merge-cover-page-background.title: Merge Cover Page as Background Using PdfFileStamp
merge-cover-page-background.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileStamp and Stamp to apply the first page of a cover PDF as a background on all pages of another PDF, creating a merged document.

add-confidential-text-and-logo-stamp.title: Add Confidential Text and Logo Stamp to PDF
add-confidential-text-and-logo-stamp.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades to place a combined formatted text stamp and a logo image onto a PDF document.

apply-custom-line-height-stamp.title: Apply Custom Line-Height Stamp to PDF
apply-custom-line-height-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to create a multi‑line watermark with custom line spacing using a formatted text stamp and apply it to all pages of a PDF.

rotate-text-stamp-on-pdf-pages.title: Rotate Text Stamp on PDF Pages
rotate-text-stamp-on-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates creating a formatted text stamp, setting its rotation to 90 degrees, and applying it to all pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-footer-with-page-count.title: Add Footer with Page Count to PDF
add-footer-with-page-count.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileStamp to add a footer that displays the current page number and total page count on each page of a PDF document.

combine-multiple-pdfs-into-multi-page-st.title: Combine Multiple PDFs into a Multi‑Page Stamp
combine-multiple-pdfs-into-multi-page-st.description: Shows how to concatenate several PDF files into a single multi‑page PDF and apply it as a stamp to all pages of another PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-custom-border-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Custom Border Stamp Annotation to PDF
add-custom-border-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create a rubber‑stamp annotation with a custom red border and thickness, place it on a page, and save the modified document.

batch-add-rotated-image-stamp-to-first-p.title: Batch Add Rotated Image Stamp to First Page of PDFs
batch-add-rotated-image-stamp-to-first-p.description: Shows how to loop through a directory of PDF files and apply a rotated image stamp to the first page of each document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

apply-image-stamp-to-all-pdf-pages.title: Apply Image Stamp to All PDF Pages
apply-image-stamp-to-all-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates using PdfFileStamp and Stamp to add a semi‑transparent image stamp to every page of a PDF in a single operation.

add-file-name-header-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add File Name Header Stamp to PDF
add-file-name-header-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates creating a TextStamp that shows the PDF's file name in the header of each page and applying it to all pages of the document.

add-semi-transparent-background-stamp.title: Add Semi-Transparent Background Stamp to PDF
add-semi-transparent-background-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to apply an image as a background stamp on all pages of a PDF with 30% opacity using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, preserving document readability.

add-multi-line-text-watermark.title: Add Multi‑Line Text Watermark with Varying Font Sizes
add-multi-line-text-watermark.description: Demonstrates how to apply a multi‑line watermark to each page of a PDF, using different font sizes for visual hierarchy and semi‑transparent rendering.

stamp-pdf-with-dynamic-barcode.title: Stamp PDF with Dynamic Barcode Using Document ID
stamp-pdf-with-dynamic-barcode.description: Demonstrates how to generate a barcode from a PDF's unique identifier and stamp it onto the original document using Aspose.Pdf facades.

apply-rotated-text-stamp-odd-pages.title: Apply Rotated Text Stamp to Odd Pages
apply-rotated-text-stamp-odd-pages.description: Demonstrates adding a 30‑degree rotated text stamp to the left margin of every odd‑numbered page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-dynamic-text-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Dynamic Text Stamp to PDF
add-dynamic-text-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates creating a TextStamp with interpolated author and date values, applying it to each page of a PDF, and saving the stamped document.

add-repeating-background-watermark-image.title: Add Repeating Background Watermark Image to PDF Pages
add-repeating-background-watermark-image.description: Shows how to use PdfFileStamp with a single Stamp instance to place a semi‑transparent background image watermark on every page of a PDF.

add-qr-code-stamp-from-pdf-metadata.title: Add QR Code Stamp from PDF Metadata
add-qr-code-stamp-from-pdf-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to generate a QR code from a PDF's metadata and apply it as a stamp on the document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multi-line-colored-header-stamp.title: Add Multi-Line Colored Header Stamp to PDF
add-multi-line-colored-header-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to apply a multi‑line header stamp with different font colors to each line using Aspose.Pdf Facades.
